name: embrace_close
desc: Same scene on the floor, but make them press together tightly with gravity: the heavy pink goo Doberman sags and slumps down onto the crocodile under its own weight, pressing flat against it with no gap and no empty space between their bodies, squashing the small black witch cat firmly between their chests, its gooey body drooping and spreading over the crocodile. The crocodile lies underneath sunk into the floor puddle; any leg or foot shapes at the bottom melt completely into the sticky puddle (no legs, no feet). Keep the heads, faces, white eyes and teeth, the cat's black fur and purple hat, colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style.
